BoostOnLargeWhaleShift.title: Large Whale Position Shift
BoostOnLargeWhaleShift.summary: A significant token transfer involving a known whale wallet or mint event was detected.
BoostOnLargeWhaleShift.why_flagged: Large transfers associated with high-balance wallets may reflect strategic accumulation, distribution, or treasury-level movement.
BoostOnLargeWhaleShift.contextual_risk: Whale-driven movements can precede liquidity rebalancing, market repositioning, or short-term volatility spikes.

BoostOnLiquidityShock.title: Protocol Liquidity Movement
BoostOnLiquidityShock.summary: A large token transfer originating from a protocol-controlled contract was identified.
BoostOnLiquidityShock.why_flagged: Protocol contracts typically manage treasury funds, liquidity pools, or emission mechanisms. Significant transfers may indicate rebalancing or withdrawal events.
BoostOnLiquidityShock.contextual_risk: Abrupt liquidity shifts can reduce market depth, alter yield conditions, or precede governance and treasury actions.

FailedTxBurstStrategy.title: Burst of Failed Transactions
FailedTxBurstStrategy.summary: Multiple failed transactions were detected from the same wallet within a short time window.
FailedTxBurstStrategy.why_flagged: Repeated failures may indicate contract probing, parameter testing, or exploit reconnaissance activity.
FailedTxBurstStrategy.contextual_risk: Attackers often generate failed calls to observe contract behavior before executing successful exploit attempts.

FlaggedMethodsStrategy.title: Privileged Contract Method Execution
FlaggedMethodsStrategy.summary: A transaction invoked a method classified as privileged or administratively sensitive.
FlaggedMethodsStrategy.why_flagged: Functions such as ownership transfers, upgrades, or administrative controls provide elevated authority over protocol logic.
FlaggedMethodsStrategy.contextual_risk: Execution of privileged methods may enable contract upgrades, parameter changes, or treasury control adjustments.

WhaleLargeTransferStrategy.title: Large Whale Transfer
WhaleLargeTransferStrategy.summary: A high-volume transfer was initiated by a wallet classified as a whale.
WhaleLargeTransferStrategy.why_flagged: Large holders can significantly influence liquidity conditions and short-term market behavior.
WhaleLargeTransferStrategy.contextual_risk: Substantial whale transfers may precede liquidity withdrawals, redistribution events, or volatility expansion.

OwnerAdminActionStrategy.title: Owner-Only Admin Action
OwnerAdminActionStrategy.summary: An owner wallet executed an administrative contract method.
OwnerAdminActionStrategy.why_flagged: Owner-restricted functions can immediately alter privileged settings and operational controls.
OwnerAdminActionStrategy.contextual_risk: Owner admin actions may change protocol parameters, permissions, or treasury paths with immediate downstream impact.
